tasks.audit: deno audit --frozen --level=high --lock deno.lock && deno audit --frozen --level=high --lock apps/web/deno.lock && deno audit --frozen --level=high --lock apps/cli/deno.lock && deno audit --frozen --level=high --lock apps/daemon/deno.lock
tasks.fmt: deno fmt deno.json apps/cli apps/cloud apps/daemon apps/runtime scripts shared tests apps/web/deno.json apps/web/main.ts apps/web/client.ts apps/web/utils.ts apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/web/routes apps/web/src
tasks.fmt:check: deno fmt --check deno.json apps/cli apps/cloud apps/daemon apps/runtime scripts shared tests apps/web/deno.json apps/web/main.ts apps/web/client.ts apps/web/utils.ts apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/web/routes apps/web/src
tasks.lint: deno lint apps/cli apps/cloud apps/daemon apps/runtime scripts shared tests apps/web/main.ts apps/web/client.ts apps/web/utils.ts apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/web/routes apps/web/src
tasks.check: deno check apps/cli/**/*.ts apps/cloud/**/*.ts apps/daemon/**/*.ts apps/runtime/**/*.ts scripts/**/*.ts apps/web/src/**/*.ts shared/**/*.ts tests/**/*.ts && deno task --cwd apps/web check
tasks.ci:quality: deno task fmt --check && deno task lint && deno task check --frozen
tasks.ci: deno task audit && deno task fmt --check && deno task lint && deno task check --frozen && deno task test --frozen
